title: Diploma in Computer Engineering | KST KPGU
content: Admission Inquiry Academics / KST Computer Engineering Krishna School of Technology prepares future-ready computer engineers through strong fundamentals, modern labs, and innovation-led learning. LEADERSHIP NOTE Message From the HOD KST Dr. Rocky Upadhyay Head of Department, Computer Engineering dr.rockyupadhyay.it.kset@kpgu.ac.in In today’s dynamic world, computer engineering stands at the forefront of transforming industries and driving technological advancements. Our department aims to prepare students not only to meet current demands but to innovate for the future. We strive to create a rigorous academic environment that encourages critical thinking, creativity, and practical problem-solving. Our department is committed to fostering an environment of learning, innovation, and collaboration. With rapid technological advancements shaping the world, our mission is to equip students with the skills, knowledge, and mindset needed to excel in an ever-evolving field. Our curriculum combines strong foundational courses with opportunities to explore cutting-edge areas such as Software Development, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Cybersecurity, IoT, Cloud Computing etc. Through practical labs, industry interactions, and real-world projects, we ensure that our students develop hands-on experience alongside theoretical knowledge. Our faculty are passionate educators and experienced professionals dedicated to student success, who bring a blend of academic and industry expertise, guide and mentor students, helping them build the competencies needed to thrive in competitive environments. We also encourage our students to engage in research, internships, and extracurricular activities to enhance their overall development and employability. We take pride in our graduates, who have gone on to make significant contributions in their fields, both in industry and academia. By joining the Department of Computer Engineering, you become part of a vibrant community focused on advancing knowledge and making a positive impact on society. As part of the global community of computer engineers, we are committed to nurturing talent that contributes meaningfully to society and technological progress. Let’s build a brighter, tech-enabled future together! ABOUT DEPARTMENT Computer Engineering at KST 01 The Department of Computer Engineering was established in 2023 and is focused on delivering top-notch computing education. 02 A rigorous and industry-focused curriculum helps students stay updated with cutting-edge technologies while building core technical and soft skills. 03 Strong emphasis is placed on practical learning through projects, industrial training and certification opportunities, making students industry-ready. 04 The program offers opportunities in domestic and international markets and supports innovation-led learning using modern labs and software resources. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Vision To evolve as a center of excellence in Computer Science & Engineering and to prepare value driven, globally competent Computer Engineers by imparting quality education through innovation, research, collaboration and contribute in the development of society at large. 01 To produce computer professionals and technocrats through proficient mentors and researchers to satisfy global needs. 02 To foster the state-of-art technologies and extend the platform to inculcate innovation and interdisciplinary research 03 To imbibe moral and ethical values that creates responsible citizens with great human values & interpersonal skills 04 To strengthen the partnership with industries, research organizations, and educational institutions that will enable the young graduate to emerge as a leader in academics or in entrepreneurship SPECIALIZATION PATHS Honors & Minors Offered Broadly Honors / Minor Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Honors / Minor Cyber Security Honors / Minor Embedded System Honors / Minor Full Stack Web Development INFRASTRUCTURE Computer Labs 01 Data Structure and Algorithms Lab 02 Computer Programming Lab 03 Database Management System Lab 04 Advance Software Design and Development Lab RESEARCH AREAS Domains of Inquiry and Innovation 01 Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning 02 Computer Systems, Networks, and Security 03 Data Science 04 Computer Vision/Graphics/Robotics 05 Cyber Security 06 Internet of Things 07 High Performance Computing 08 Human-Computer Interaction 09 Natural Language Processing & Information Retrieval 10 Quantum Computing 11 Software Engineering 12 Theory of Computation 13 Bioinformatics FACULTY & STAFF Academic Team Dr.Rocky Upadhyay Associate Professor, HoD -
